name: Kelyn Trigos
description: Kelyn Trigos is a tall, red-skinned Tiefling who serves as a receptionist, enforcer, and gatekeeper at the Terasse Estate, acting as a front for the city's corrupt elite and guarding the secret portal to the Undermountain[cite: 1]. He possesses a sneering, feline attitude and watches visitors with sharp, evaluating eyes[cite: 1].
ideals: Secrecy: 'The House of Healing is closed to the public unless the humors truly demand it[cite: 1].'
bonds: The Terasse Estate and its covert underground gambling and bloodsport operations[cite: 1].
flaws: Arrogant and prone to mocking visitors whom he deems unrefined or suspicious[cite: 1].
speech_patterns: Purring, smooth, and mocking, dropping into feline recognition when encountering old acquaintances or archivists[cite: 1].
mannerisms: Leans against doorframes, aggressively rubs visitor's sleeve fabric to inspect its quality, and watches guests with a sharp, feline gaze[cite: 1].
motivations: To vet visitors and maintain the absolute security and secrecy of the Terasse Estate's portal[cite: 1].
knowledge: Code words, visitor vetting procedures, and front operations for the Terasse Estate portal[cite: 1].
gm_notes: Kelyn Trigos serves as an initial social filter for characters attempting to infiltrate the Xanathar's games via the Terasse Estate front[cite: 1]. He can test players through clothing inspections, attitude checks, and code-phrase verifications[cite: 1].
